A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Ingqekembe yeKulottunga Chola enesihloko esithi "Malai Nadu konda Chola" - iChola eyathatha ilizwe leenduli, oko kukuthi, umhlaba waseChera. A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Ingqekembe ye-Rajaraja I. Iingqekembe zakhe zobhedu zohlobo olumileyo-ukumkani kunye nomfanekiso ohleliyo, owaziswa emva kokunqoba kwakhe enyakatho yeSri Lanka, yajikeleza ngokubanzi kumacala omabini olwandle kwaye yaxeliswa ngeenkulungwane.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Ingqekembe yobukumkani baseJaffna ebonisa ihashe elinentlanzi. Ookumkani baseTamil baseJaffna (inkulungwane ye-13 ukuya kweye-17) bakhupha iingqekembe kwisithethe saseMzantsi Indian, isikhumbuzo sobudlelwane obusondeleyo kwiPalk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Ingqekembe yeKongu Cheras, umgca weChera owawulawula ilizwe laseKongu kummandla osentshonalanga weTamil (malunga neCoimbatore yangoku, i-Erode kunye neKarur) - ummandla ofanayo oye wavelisa i-hoards ecebileyo yemali yaseRoma.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Umntu othweswe isithsaba, onemivimbo kwiprofayile, enxibe ibhatyi enamatye anqabileyo kunye nezikhafu eziqukuqelayo, uphakamisa abasebenzi abanentsiba. A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Iinkcukacha zesilingi epeyintiweyo yomqolomba kaJain eSittanavasal: iilowusi ezipinki zivuleka phakathi kweepads eziluhlaza, isilwanyana esihamba emanzini kunye nomfanekiso oqokelela iintyatyambo. A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Inqanawa yomngcwabo evela kwiindawo zokungcwaba zeenduli zeNilgiri, isiciko sayo sithweswe isithsaba semifanekiso eqingqiweyo. A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Isidanga seendinyana ezimalunga nekhulu elinamashumi amahlanu eevesi zikaKanimethaviyar, ezinye ezingamashumi amathathu kwindawo nganye kwezintlanu.

A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Isiqingatha segolide-kahavanu saseVirarajendra Chola (1063-1070 CE). I-Kahavanu (esuka kakapana) yayiyinkonzo yegolide yaseSri Lanka, kwaye i-Chola yegolide yabetha kulo mgangatho ibonisa ixesha lokulawula kweChola phezu kwesiqithi.

A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Umbongo wesikhokelo see-Idyll ezilishumi nguMudathama Kanniyar. I-drum-playing bard (i-porunar) oye wavuzwa ngokutyebileyo ukhokela enye i-bard ukuya kukumkani waseChola onesisa uKarikal Valavan.

A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Ingqayi ebhalwe ngesiTamil-Brahmi, efunyenwe eTissamaharama kumazantsi eSri Lanka kwaye yabhalwa malunga nekhulu le-2 BCE. A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Isikhokelo esifutshane esinemifanekiso yeendwendwe: yintoni imibongo yeSangam, ihlelwe njani, kwaye isebenza njani imibongo ye-kam kunye ne-puram kunye nemimandla emihlanu.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: I-kasu yesilivere yeRajendra Chola edibanisa iimpawu zasebukhosini - ingwe yeChola kunye nentlanzi yasePandya kunye ne-Chera isaphetha. The eri system was a major part of tradi: Inkqubo ye-eri yayiyinxalenye enkulu yolawulo lwamanzi emveli eTamil Nadu. I-eri yitanki yokunkcenkceshela eyenziweyo eyenzelwe ukuqokelela nokugcina amanzi emvula kunye nokubaleka kwamanzi. Ngexesha lemvula, amanzi ayeqokelelana emva kodonga lodongwe. Yayinokukhutshelwa ezolimo xa imvula iyancipha. La matanki ayexabiseke ngokukodwa kwiindawo ezingenalo ukufikelela ngokuthembekileyo kwimilambo ehlala ihleli. Amanzi agciniweyo axhasa ukulinywa kwepaddy kunye nezinye izityalo, ngelixa iibhedi zetanki kunye nomhlaba ojikelezileyo wawuyinxalenye yommandla wezolimo welali. Kweminye imimandla, amatanki acwangciswe ngokulandelelana okudityanisiweyo: ukuphuphuma kwetanki ephezulu kunokuhamba ukuya kwitanki esezantsi, ukunceda uluntu ukuba lusebenzise imvula yamaxesha athile kwindawo ebanzi. I-eri yayingaphezu kwesakhiwo sokugcina amanzi. Yayiyinxalenye yenkqubo yelali ebanzi eyayifuna ukuchithwa rhoqo, ukulungiswa kunye nolawulo oludibeneyo. Xa egcinwe kakuhle, amatanki anceda ekunciphiseni ilahleko yamanzi ngokubaleka okungalawulekiyo kunye nokuphucula ukufumaneka kwamanzi ngamaxesha omileyo.

The image of Shiva as Nataraja, Lord of: Umfanekiso weShiva njengoNataraja, iNkosi yoMdaniso, ukudansa ngaphakathi kwindandatho yomlilo, yeyona ndlela idumileyo yobhedu yeChola. Ivakalisa umjikelo wendalo yonke wendalo, ukulondolozwa, kunye nokutshatyalaliswa.
The Jambai inscription in Villupuram dis: Umbhalo weJambai kwisithili saseVillupuram amagama athi "Satiyaputo Atiyan Netuman Anci", edibanisa iinkosi ze-Atiyaman kunye neSatiyaputa ekhankanywe kwi-Ashoka's edicts.
The Kailasanatha Temple, a Pallava-perio: Ithempeli laseKailasanatha, itempile yamatye yePallava-ixesha, kunye neendawo ezincinci ezihambelana nendawo ebiyelweyo.
The kalayam, the everyday Tamil clay pot: I-kalayam, imbiza yodongwe ye-Tamil yemihla ngemihla. The Kallanai, or Grand Anicut, across th: I-Kallanai, okanye i-Grand Anicut, ngaphesheya kweKaveri - ngokuqhelekileyo kuthiwa yi-Chola ukumkani uKarikala - yakhiwe ukulawula nokuguqula amanzi omlambo kwimigudu yokunkcenkceshela. The Kanchipuram silk saree is one of the: I-Kanchipuram i-silk saree yenye yezona mpahla zidumileyo zaseTamil Nadu. Isuka eKanchipuram, iziko lembali lokuluka, le saree idume ngelaphu lesilika elityebileyo, umsebenzi ontsonkothileyo wezari, imida eyahlukileyo, kunye neepateni ezicacileyo. Iimpawu zemveli ziquka iinqaba zetempile, iipikoko, iimango, iintyatyambo, kunye noyilo lwejometri. Isaree ilukwe kusetyenziswa umsonto wesilika, kunye nemisonto yezari enemibala yegolide okanye yesilivere yongeza ubutyebi bokuhombisa. I-Kanchipuram silk sarees ibambe indawo ebalulekileyo kwimitshato yaseTamil, imikhosi yenkolo, imikhosi, kunye nezinye iziganeko ezikhethekileyo. Inkqubo yokuluka ifuna isakhono esibonakalayo, ngakumbi xa ujoyina umzimba, umda, kunye ne-pallu usebenzisa ubuchule bokudibanisa bendabuko. Umsebenzi wobugcisa uphuhliswe kwizizukulwana, kwaye owona nyaka wokusekwa kwawo awuqinisekiswanga ngokwembali. I-Kancheepuram Silk ifumene ukuqatshelwa kwe-Geographical Indication (GI) ngo-2005. Namhlanje, i-saree imele ilifa lelifa le-Tamil Nadu le-textile, ubugcisa bezakhono, kunye nokuphila okuqhubekayo koluntu olulukwayo lwendabuko.
The Kandangi saree is a traditional cott: I-Kandangi saree yi-cotton textile yendabuko ehambelana nommandla wase-Chettinad, ngakumbi i-Karaikudi kunye neendawo ezikufutshane. Yaziwa ngokutshekishwa kwayo ngqindilili, imivimbo, imida eyahlukileyo, kunye nemibala eyomeleleyo, kubandakanya obomvu, isardadi, iorenji, kunye nomdaka womhlaba. Ngokwesiko, i-cotton fabric eqinile yayifanelekile ukusetyenziswa rhoqo, ebonisa iimfuno eziphathekayo zempahla yemihla ngemihla. I-Kandangi weaving imele ubuhle obahlukileyo kunye nolwazi olulukiweyo lwengingqi yaseChettinad. Iipateni zayo kunye nendibaniselwano yemibala iyahlula kwezinye izithethe ezininzi zaseMazantsi eIndiya. Inkqubo yokuvelisa ibandakanya ukulungiselela umsonto, ukulungisa imisonto kwi-loom, ukuluka ilaphu, kunye nokugqiba imida kunye nokugqiba. Imathiriyeli yesandla sikarhulumente ichaza esi sithethe njengesele sikho ngaphezu kweminyaka eyi-150, nangona unyaka wokuqala ochanekileyo uhlala ungaqinisekanga. I-Kandangi sarees ifumene ukuqatshelwa kwe-GI ngo-2019, inceda ukuchonga nokugcina isazisi sabo sengingqi kunye nobugcisa bendabuko.
The Kaveri in spate below the Grand Anic: I-Kaveri kwi-spate engezantsi kwe-Grand Anicut. Iimbongi zaseTamil zancoma ilizwe leChola njengelizwe laseKaveri, i-famaty yayo ayizange iphumelele; iSilappatakaram iyibhiyozela njengelizwe lepaddy engenamda. I-anicut yajika loo nzuzo ibe yinkqubo elawulwayo, kwaye i-delta yaba sisitya serayisi selizwe laseTamil.
The Koorainadu saree is associated with: I-Koorainadu saree idibene neKoorainadu kufuphi neMayiladuthurai eTamil Nadu. Idityaniswa ngakumbi nesinxibo somtshato wesintu kunye nentsingiselo yenkcubeko yamalaphu kwizithethe zomtshato waseTamil. Iindidi zemveli ziquka amalaphu esilika kunye nesilika-umqhaphu, kunye noyilo olwahlukileyo kunye nezinto ezisetyenziswayo ngokwesitayile kunye nenjongo ethile. I-saree ibonisa indima yeempahla ezilukiweyo kwimibhiyozo yentsapho ebalulekileyo kunye nokuhanjiswa kwezithethe ze-textile phakathi kwezizukulwana. Inkangeleko yayo, ilaphu, kunye neempawu zokuhombisa zinokwahluka, ngoko ke imizekelo yomntu ngamnye kufuneka ibhalwe ngokolwakhiwo lwawo lokwenene kunokuba kucingelwa ukuba yonke i-Koorainadu saree ilandela uyilo olufanayo. Unyaka ochanekileyo wemvelaphi yesi siko awumiselwanga ngokuqinileyo. I-Koorainadu sarees ihlala isisifundo esibalulekileyo sokuhlola ubudlelwane phakathi kwempahla, isazisi sengingqi, ubugcisa, kunye nobomi bomsitho eTamil Nadu.
The Kovai Kora cotton saree is associate: I-Kovai Kora cotton saree inxulunyaniswa ne-Coimbatore kunye nommandla ojikelezayo wokuvelisa amalaphu. Yenziwe ngomqhaphu, iyaxatyiswa ngenxa yobuhle bayo obungachazwanga, ukuthungwa kwayo kakuhle, kunye nemida yemveli. Xa kuthelekiswa neesaree zesilika ezihonjiswe kakhulu, iilaphu zeKoran zomqhaphu zihlala zigxininisa inkangeleko yendalo yomqhaphu, ukunxiba okusebenzayo, kunye neenkcukacha zoyilo oluchuliweyo. I-saree ibonisa ukubaluleka kokulinywa komqhaphu, ukuveliswa kwentambo, ukuthunga, kunye norhwebo lwamalaphu eTamil Nadu. Ukuvelisa i-handloom saree kufuna ukulungiswa ngononophelo kwe-warp kunye ne-weft threads kunye nokusebenza ngezakhono kwe-loom. Ikotoni yeKora ifanelekile kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo, kubandakanywa ukugqoka kwansuku zonke kunye neendibano ezisemthethweni. I-Kovai Kora Cotton ifumene ukuqatshelwa kwe-GI kwi-2008. Unyaka wayo ochanekileyo awusungulwa, kodwa isithethe sihlala singumzekelo obalulekileyo welifa lemveli le-cotton-weaving yelizwe.
The larger digitisation catalogued under: I-digitization enkulu efakwe kwikhathalogu phantsi kwenani elifanayo, i-603 D: ngaphezu kwamakhulu amathandathu emifanekiso yamagqabi ye-bundle apho i-Kar Narpathu igcinwa khona.
The Leiden plates record a Chola grant o: Iipleyiti zeLeiden zirekhoda isibonelelo seChola kwidolophana kwi-Buddhist vihara eNagapattinam, eyalelwe nguRajaraja I kwaye ikhutshwe phantsi kweRajendra I. Ngoku zigcinwe eLeiden, eNetherlands.
The literary image of ancient Tamil mari: Umfanekiso wombhalo wempumelelo yaselwandle yaseTamil yakudala.
The long pillared cloister that encloses: I-cloister ende enentsika evale intendelezo yetempile yaseBrihadisvara, enomqolo we-lingams ebekwe ecaleni komgangatho wayo. Iindonga zayo zapeyintwa ngexesha leNayak kunye nemiboniso edlamkileyo - apha i-Shiva's pot-bellied ganas, abalindi bakhe abadlalayo abadlalayo - phantsi kwebhendi ye-Tamil captions. Emva kwemizobo enjalo yamva, kwipaseji ejikeleze i-sanctum, kukho imifanekiso eqingqiweyo yeChola yantlandlolo yetempile.
The longest of the Ten Idylls, by Mangud: Elona lide kakhulu kwii-Idyll ezilishumi, nguMangudi Maruthanar, ezibhekiswe kukumkani wasePandya uNedunchezhiyan. Ichaza isixeko esikhulu saseMadurai ukususela ngonyezi ukuya kubusuku kwaye ngobunono ikhumbuza ukumkani ukuba lonke uzuko lwehlabathi luyadlula.
The lotus pool of Sittanavasal, the Pall: Ichibi lelotus yaseSittanavasal, isithixokazi sikaPallava wasePanamalai, iifrescoes zeChola kunye nemizobo yaseNayak yeTempile enkulu eThanjavur, kunye nemizobo ehonjisiweyo yeTanjore.
The Madurai Sungudi saree is a tradition: I-Madurai Sungudi saree yi-cotton textile yendabuko ehambelana ne-Madurai, iziko lezenkcubeko kunye nezorhwebo kwi-Tamil Nadu. Yahlulwa ngeepateni zayo ezinamachokoza, ukuyila kwayo ngemibalabala, kunye neendlela zayo eziqhelekileyo zokubopha idayi okanye ukuxhathisa. Amacandelo amancinci endwangu aboshwe okanye akhuselwe ngexesha lokudaya ukuze enze iipatheni ezihlukeneyo xa izinto zityhilwa. Iingubo ze-Sungudi zixabiswa ngenkangeleko ekhangayo, ilaphu lomqhaphu elikhaphukhaphu, kunye nokufaneleka kwempahla yemihla ngemihla kunye neyefestive. Ubugcisa budibanisa ulwazi lokulungiswa kwelaphu, iindlela zokubopha, ukudaya, kunye nokugqiba. Imvelaphi yayo eyimbali ayidityaniswanga kunyaka wokuqala obhalwe ngokukhuselekileyo. UMadurai Sungudi wafumana ukuqatshelwa kwe-GI kwi-2005, evuma ukudibanisa kwayo nommandla. Isithethe sibonisa indlela amagcisa aseTamil aphuhlise ngayo uyilo olwahlukileyo lwelaphu esebenzisa izakhono ezikhethekileyo zokudaya kunye nemveliso esekwe ekuhlaleni.
The masonry arches that now crown the an: Ii-arches zemasonry ezithwesa isithsaba samandulo. Yaba ngabo bayibiza ngokuba yi "Grand Anicut".
The Meenakshi Amman Temple, historic str: ITempile yeMeenakshi Amman, izitalato zembali, izithethe zonqulo, kunye nokuqhubeka koncwadi nenkcubeko zidibanisa iMadurai yanamhlanje kunye nembali yayo ende.
The memorial hall to Karikal Chozhan at: Iholo lesikhumbuzo kuKarikal Chozhan eKallanai, ephakanyiswe nguRhulumente waseTamil Nadu. UKarikalan, iqhawe lePattinappalai kunye nePorunararruppadai, ukhunjulwa kwisithethe saseTamil njengokumkani owabamba iKaveri. Kamva imibongo yeChola efana neKulothunga Cholan Ula, kunye nemibhalo yeenzala ezithi ziphuma kuye, zimzukisa ngokuphakamisa iibhanki zikaKaveri.
The mini-map in the corner shows the who: Imaphu encinci ekoneni ibonisa imyuziyam yonke; utolo olubomvu nguwe, olukhomba indlela ojongene ngayo. Vula imephu epheleleyo (okanye iqhosha leMaphu) kwaye ukhethe nayiphi na iholo okanye igumbi lokuhamba apho.
The monuments of Mamallapuram, carved ma: Izikhumbuzo zeMamallapuram, eziqingqwe kakhulu kwi-7th kunye ne-8th yenkulungwane ye-CE, zibandakanya iitempile zomqolomba owenziwe ngamatye, i-monolithic rathas, kunye neTempile yaseShore eyakhiwe. Eli qela liyindawo yeLifa leMveli le-UNESCO.
The monuments themselves, with Pallava i: Izikhumbuzo ngokwazo, kunye nemibhalo yePallava kunye nezihloko zasebukhosini ezikrolwe kuzo.
The most celebrated of the Seven Great P: Eyona ibhiyozelwa kakhulu ngaBaxhasi abaKhulu abaSixhenxe. Isiko lesiTamil siyamkhumbula enikela inqwelo yakhe kwi-jasmine (mullai) creeper eyayingenanto yokukhwela-isisa esifikelela ngaphaya kwabantu kwihlabathi lendalo. Ubuhlobo bakhe kunye nombongi uKapilar, ukukhusela kwakhe uParambu Nadu ngokuchasene nookumkani abathathu abathweswe isithsaba, kunye nokulila kweentombi zakhe uAngavai noSangavai (iPurananuru 112) zigcinwe kwimibongo yaseSangam; ibali lenqwelo lifundwa kakuhle njengesithethe soncwadi.
The mountains and the land around them,: Iintaba nomhlaba ozingqongileyo, ezinzulwini zobusuku ngexesha elipholileyo. Uthixo wayo nguMurugan (Seyon), kunye nentyatyambo yayo kurinji, edubula kanye kwiminyaka elishumi elinesibini. Umxholo wayo ngu-punarthal, intlanganiso eyimfihlo yabathandi. Abantu bakhona bachola ubusi, bagada amasimi emillet kwizikhwenene baze bazingele ehlathini.
The murasu is the great drum of Sangam l: I-murasu igubu elikhulu loncwadi lweSangam, elikhanyiswa ookumkani, imfazwe, izibhengezo zoluntu kunye nemikhosi - ilizwi layo lalingumqondiso wegunya lobukhosi. Amagubu abizwa ngokuba yi-murasu mhlawumbi ahluka ngobukhulu, imathiriyeli kunye nokunqunyanyiswa ekuhambeni kwexesha, ngoko ke alikho igubu lanamhlanje elifana ngqo; Ukwakhiwa ngokutsha kukutolikwa kweetekisi.

The nadaswaram is the great double-reed: I-nadaswaram sisixhobo somoya esineengcongolo eziphindwe kabini zomculo wetempile yaseTamil, evakala kwiminyhadala, emitshatweni nakwimibhiyozo. Umzimba omde womthi onemingxuma yeminwe uphela kwintsimbi evuthayo; Ingcongolo nebhongo zikhupha isandi esinamandla. Ifuna ukulawula ukuphefumla kunye nelizwi elilungileyo, idlala i-classical improvisations emide, i-ragas kunye neengoma - ngokuqhelekileyo ibambisene ne-thavil.
The name seems to have been borne by mor: Eli gama libonakala lithwalwe ziimbongi zabasetyhini abangaphezu kwesinye. Izibongo zeSangam Avvaiyar ePurananuru, Akananuru, Kurunthogai kunye neNatrinai zithetha ngookumkani, ukupha kunye nokufa; wayengumcebisi othembekileyo ku-Adhiyaman. I-classics yabantwana i-Aathichudi, i-Kondrai Vendhan kunye ne-Nalvazhi ye-Avvaiyar kamva.
The Noyyal River region of Tamil Nadu pr: Ummandla weNoyyal River waseTamil Nadu unika omnye umzekelo wolawulo lwamanzi ngothungelwano lwamatanki kunye nemijelo ehambelana nayo. Kunokuba kuxhomekeke kuphela ekuqukuqeleni ngokuthe ngqo komlambo, abahlali baphuhlisa iinkqubo zokugcina ezinceda ukubamba nokusasaza amanzi akhoyo. Amatanki akuthungelwano olunjalo anokuqokelela imvula yamaxesha onyaka kunye nokuhamba kwamanzi, agcinelwe ukusetyenziswa kwezolimo kamva. Ukusebenziseka kwazo kwakuxhomekeke kulungiselelo lwenkangeleko yomhlaba, ubume bemigubasi, umthamo wemijelo kunye nexesha lokuna kwemvula. Xa igcinwe ngokufanelekileyo, uthungelwano oludityanisiweyo lwanceda ekusasazeni imithombo yamanzi elinganiselweyo kwiindawo ezininzi. Inkqubo yoMlambo iNoyyal ikwamkelwe kumaxwebhu elifa lemveli lamanzi aseIndiya. Ibonisa ukuba kutheni ukunkcenkceshela ngokwesintu kufuneka kuqondwe njengothungelwano lwezakhiwo ezinxulumeneyo endaweni yengqokelela yamatanki azimeleyo.
The objects of a Tamil home, the Kallana: Izinto zekhaya laseTamil, iKallanai kunye neetanki zelali, kunye nokulima ukusuka kwikhuba ukuya ekuvuneni.
The objects of a traditional Tamil home: Izinto zekhaya lemveli laseTamil - iimbiza zodongwe kunye neengqayi zengqolowa, i-ammi kunye ne-aattukkal amatye okusila, i-ural kunye ne-ulakkai, iimbiza zamanzi, izibane zeoli, iimethi, iifeni, ii-cots, iibhaskithi kunye ne-ladles - kunye nokutya kwemihla ngemihla okuphekwe kunye nabo: irayisi kunye ne-millets, i-pulses, i-koozh, i-buttermilk kunye nesidlo sebhanana.
The oldest surviving Tamil grammar, in t: Igrama endala yesiTamil esaphila, kwiincwadi ezintathu - zoonobumba, zamagama, kunye nesifundo ( porul ), apho iitinai ezintlanu zemibongo zibekwe khona.
The Pallava capital and a temple city of: Ikomkhulu lasePallava kunye nesixeko setempile yokufunda, iseliziko lonqulo kunye nokuluka isilika.
The palmyra palm provided several useful: Isundu sepalmyra sabonelela ngeemveliso ezininzi eziluncedo. Incindi yesundu inokutyiwa isentsha okanye icutshungulwe, ngelixa iswekile yesundu kunye nejaggery yesundu zisetyenziswa njengezinto ezimnandi. Iimveliso zesundu zazibaluleke kakhulu kwimimandla apho umthi wawuninzi kwaye wawuyinxalenye yokuphila kwendawo.
The pambai is a pair of drums played tog: I-pambai yipere yamagubu adlalwa kunye, amazwi awo ahlukileyo aphantsi naphakamileyo aqhuba imidlalo yabantu, imingcelele kunye neminyhadala yelali kwi-Tamil Nadu. Isiko layo eliphilayo libhalwe ngcono kunemvelaphi yalo, kwaye i-repertoire yayo iyatshintsha ukusuka kummandla ukuya kummandla kunye noluntu ukuya kuluntu.
The Pancha Rathas are monolithic shrines: I-Pancha Rathas ziindawo ezingcwele ze-monolithic nganye eqingqwe ukusuka kwindawo enye, ebonisa uluhlu lweefom zezakhiwo zetempile ematyeni.
The Pandya capital on the Vaigai, closel: I-capital Pandya kwi-Vaigai, iboshwe ngokusondeleyo kwizithethe zeTamil Sangam kunye nezibongo zakudala.
The parai is a Tamil frame drum: a circu: I-parai yidramu yesakhelo seTamil: isakhelo esisetyhula kunye nenwebu eyoluliweyo, ebethelwa ngababetha kwiipatheni zesingqisho. Kudala isebenzela izibhengezo, amasiko, iminyhadala kunye nemingcwabo, kwaye iparai attam yanamhlanje ijoyina igubu ukudanisa. Imbali yayo ikwaphethe i-caste hierarchy eyayijongela phantsi abadlali abaninzi belifa - kwaye kwinkcubeko yesiTamil namhlanje iparai idlalwa ukungqina ubuni, isidima kunye nokulingana.
The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea names: IPeriplus yoLwandle lwase-Erythraean ibiza iTyndis phakathi kwamazibuko onxweme olusentshona, kummandla wokumkani waseChera, yaye uncwadi lwesiTamil lukhumbula izibuko elibizwa ngokuba yiTondi. Apho ibimi khona akuqinisekanga: iTanur, iPonnani kunye neKadalundi zonke zicetyiwe, kwaye idolophu yanamhlanje yaseThondi kunxweme olukumazantsi-mpuma eTamil Nadu ayinakuchongwa ngayo yonke ireferensi yakudala. I-Tyndis iqondwa kakuhle ngendawo yayo phakathi kwamazibuko e-Malabar kunye neendlela zangaphakathi emva kwazo.
The ports and trading centres of ancient: Amazibuko namaziko okurhweba aseTalakam yamandulo—iPuhar neArikamedu kunxweme olusempuma, iKorkai neAlagankulam kwilizwe lasePandya, iMuziris neTyndis ngasentshona, neUraiyur, iKarur neKodumanal phakathi—ngalinye likwincwadi yeefoto zokumbiwa kwalo.
The pullanguzhal, the bamboo flute, is b: I-pullanguzhal, ifluti ye-bamboo, ivuthelwa kwindawo evulekileyo ngelixa iminwe igquma kwaye ityhila imingxuma yayo. Kwimibongo yaseSangam imbande yekamullai, indawo yokwalusa yabelusi namahlathi; namhlanje iviwa kumculo wesintu, wezonqulo noweklasiki ngokufanayo. Imbande yomfundisi wemibongo ingumxholo woncwadi, nangona-ayibo ubungqina bokuba yonke imbande yakudala yayisisixhobo esifanayo.
The red arrow is you, pointing where you: Utolo olubomvu nguwe, owalatha apho ujonge khona.
The region’s archaeological evidence, li: Ubungqina bezinto zakudala zommandla, iimbekiselo zoncwadi, indawo eselunxwemeni kunye nemiboniso yenkcubeko inceda abatyeleli baqonde ukubaluleka kwayo kwimbali.
The reverse of a coin naming Uttama Chol: Umva wengqekembe ebizwa ngokuba yi-Uttama Chola (c. 970-985 CE), iingqekembe zayo zesilivere ziphakathi kwemiba yokuqala yeChola yokuthwala igama lokumkani - apha kwiskripthi seGrantha esisetyenziselwa isiSanskrit kwilizwe laseTamil.
The reverse of a Setu coin, where the le: Umva wengqekembe yeSetu, apho kubhalwe ilivo elithi “Setu”. Ukufunda imibhalo kubuso bobabini bengqekembe - i-obverse kunye ne-reverse - yindlela ama-numismatists achonga ngayo ukuba ngubani owakhupha kwaye nini.
The revived Pandya kingdom continued to: Ubukumkani obuvuselelweyo bePandya baqhubeka nokusebenzisa uphawu lweentlanzi, bahlala bebonisa iintlanzi ezimbini, ngamanye amaxesha ngentonga okanye isibane.
The ripe paddy is cut by hand with sickl: Umlindi ovuthiweyo usikwa ngesandla ngamarhengqa, uze ubhulwe ukuze kwahlulwe iinkozo kwiindiza uze weliwe ukuze kususwe umququ. Isivuno sondla amakhaya kunye neemarike, kwaye ingeniso yomhlaba evela kuyo yagcina amagunya alawulayo - ezolimo zixhasa ukufuywa kweenkomo, ukulungiswa kweenkozo, ukuthutha kunye norhwebo ecaleni kwayo.
The river that fed the Chola kingdom’s a: Umlambo owawudlisa ezolimo zobukumkani beChola kunye nemibongo yayo yobuninzi.

The rock-cut caves, sculptural reliefs,: Imiqolomba ye-rock-cut, i-sculptural reliefs, i-rathas ye-monolithic kunye neetempile zesakhiwo zinika ubungqina obuchanekileyo bempumelelo yobugcisa bePallava.
The Salem silk saree is associated with: ISalem silk saree inxulunyaniswa neSalem, indawo ebalulekileyo yokuvelisa ilaphu eTamil Nadu. Zilukwe kusetyenziswa umsonto wesilika, ezi saree ziza ngemibala eyahlukeneyo, uyilo lomda kunye neepateni zokuhombisa. Inkangeleko yabo inokususela kuyilo olulula kunye nobuhle ukuya kwimpahla eyongezelelekileyo eyenzelwe imitshato, iminyhadala kunye nezinye izihlandlo ezikhethekileyo. Ilifa le-Salem yempahla yelifa liqhagamshelwe kuphuhliso olubanzi lwemveliso yesilika, ukuluka, kunye neemarike ezirhweba ngamalaphu eTamil Nadu. Umsebenzi wezandla ufuna umsebenzi onobuchule ekulungiseni umsonto, ukuseka intambo yokuluka, ukugcina ukutsalwa okungaguqukiyo kokuluka, nokugqiba ilaphu. I-Salem Silk ifumene ukuqatshelwa kwe-GI ngo-2007, ivuma ngokusemthethweni isazisi sayo sengingqi. Lo mhla wokubhalisa awubonisi ukuba isithethe saqala nini. The sea and the shore, at dusk in every: Ulwandle nonxweme, ngongcwalazi ngamaxesha onke. Uthixo wayo nguVarunan, inkosi yamanzi, kunye nentyatyambo yayo iblue water-lily (neithal). Umxholo wayo ngu-irangal-ixhala lokukhala njengoko iqhawekazi lijonge ulwandle kwisikhephe sesithandwa salo. Abantu bayo bayaloba, bayomisa ababambisileyo baze benze ityuwa kwiipani eziselunxwemeni.
The sea routes that joined the Tamil coa: Iindlela zolwandle ezihlangene nonxweme lwaseTamil ukuya kuLwandle oluBomvu, iMeditera kunye ne-South-East Asia, i-architecture yamachweba - i-wharves, amaqula kunye ne-quays yezitena - kunye neengqayi, udongwe kunye nempahla ehamba phakathi kwabo - kunye ne-Adichanallur, indawo yokungcwaba ye-Iron Age kwintlambo yaseThamirabarani, kwi-still kunye nefilimu.
The secret of Kallanai’s endurance: clay: Imfihlelo yonyamezelo lukaKallanai: udongwe kunye nentlenga ye-silt ethathwe zizikhukhula yasebenza kwiindawo eziphakathi kwamatye kwaye zitywinwe. The shore at Poompuhar in Mayiladuthurai: Unxweme lwasePoompuhar kwisithili saseMayiladuthurai, apho uguquko lonxweme kunye nokukhukuliseka kuphinde kwalungisa indawo yechweba lakudala.
The shore at Poompuhar today, near the m: Unxweme lwasePoompuhar namhlanje, kufutshane nomlomo weKaveri, apho ichweba laseChola lasePuhar lalikade likhona. Uphando lwangaphantsi kwamanzi lufumene i-masonry elunxwemeni; ukuba isixeko samandulo safikelela phi, kunye nendlela unxweme olutshintshe ngayo, kusahlolisiswa.
The Shore Temple and its grounds beside: ITempile yaseShore kunye neendawo zayo ezisecaleni kolwandle, zibonwa phezulu.

The shortest of the Ten Idylls, by Nappu: Eyona imfutshane kwii-Idyll ezilishumi, nguNapputanar. Ibekwe kumhlaba wehlathi (mullai) ngexesha lemvula, ibonisa umfazi elinde ngomonde umyeni wakhe ukuba abuye emfazweni.
The signature pottery of the Tamil Iron: Udongwe olutyikityiweyo lweTamil Iron Age luyimpahla emnyama nabomvu: ebomvu ngaphandle, emnyama ecwebezelayo ngaphakathi nasemphethweni. Ababumbi baphumelela ngokudubula izitya zijongise ezantsi, ukuze inxalenye ekhuselweyo emoyeni ibe mnyama. Uninzi lweembiza ezinjalo ziphethe amanqaku okanye i-graffiti ekrwelwe kudongwe, kwaye ukususela kwixesha lembali yokuqala ukuya phambili, amagama abhalwe ngesiTamil-Brahmi - isicatshulwa esidala kunazo zonke saseTamil - eKeeladi, eKodumanal, e-Arikamedu nakude njengeSri Lanka, eThailand kunye nonxweme loLwandle oluBomvu eYiputa.
The surviving halls, pillars, arches and: Iiholo eziseleyo, iintsika, ii-arches kunye nentendelezo zigcina imizekelo ebalulekileyo ye-architecture ye-Nayak, nangona yonke i-complex yokuqala ayisekho.
The temple complex from above, within th: Isakhiwo setempile esivela phezulu, ngaphakathi kwesixeko sanamhlanje saseThanjavur.
The temple enclosure seen from directly: Indawo ebiyelweyo yetempile ebonwa ngokuthe ngqo phezulu: i-vimana, i-mandapa ende, iindawo ezingcwele ezijikeleze intendelezo kunye nengonyama ejikelezayo ejongene kakuhle kufutshane nomnyango.
The temple from the air, its gopurams ri: Itempile evela emoyeni, iigopuram zayo zinyuka phezu kwezitrato zesixeko sanamhlanje esakhula ngeenxa zonke kuyo.
The temple, sculptural details, inscript: Itempile, iinkcukacha eziqingqiweyo, imibhalo kunye neentsalela zezinto zakudala zigcina ubungqina bokubaluleka kobukhosi kunye nonqulo lwesayithi.
The temple’s own inscriptions record its: Imibhalo yetempile ngokwayo irekhoda isakhiwo sayo, izibonelelo kunye nabasebenzi ngokweenkcukacha.
The Ten Idylls and the Eight Anthologies: I-Idyll ezilishumi kunye nee-Anthologies ezisibhozo - izibongo zokuqala zesiTamil, kwii-CICT editions.
The Thamirabarani — known in Tamil as th: I-Thamirabarani - eyaziwayo ngesiTamil njengePorunai - idlula kwinduli yokungcwaba kwindlela eya kwiGulf of Mannar. Ezantsi kwakulele iKorkai, izibuko lasePandya elalidume ngeeperile zalo; njengoko ifilimu ibonisa, abantu bale ntlambo banokufikelela elwandle, kunye neendlela ezingaphaya kwayo, ngendlela yomlambo. Umlambo wanika intlambo amasimi achumileyo, amanzi kunye nendlela eya elunxwemeni.
The thavil, closely tied to the Thanjavu: I-thavil, eboshwe ngokusondeleyo kwingingqi ye-Thanjavur, igubhu elifana ne-barrel enentloko ekupheleni kwayo, idlalwe ngesandla esinye entloko kunye nentonga emfutshane kwenye. Kwi-nadaswaram ensemble yenza okungaphezulu kakhulu kunokugcina ixesha: abadlali abanobuchule baphendula ingoma ngokuguquguquka kwesingqisho kunye namandla, ngokuvakalayo ngokwaneleyo kwimingcelele yangaphandle kunye neendibano ezinkulu zetempile.
The Thirubuvanam silk saree originates f: I-saree ye-silk ye-Thirubuvanam ivela e-Thirubuvanam kwingingqi ye-Thanjavur yaseTamil Nadu. Imele isiko elikhethekileyo lokuluka isilika apho amagcisa enza amalaphu esilika amibalabala ahonjiswe ngemida elukiweyo kunye nentsingiselo yemveli. Ngokuxhomekeke kuyilo, i-saree inokuthi ibonise iipatheni ezicacileyo, imibala eyahlukileyo, kunye nezinto zokuhombisa ezifanelekileyo kwimpahla yomthendeleko kunye nemikhosi. Isithethe sibonisa unxulumano olude lommandla kunye nobuchwephesha belaphu kunye nokuhanjiswa kolwazi lokuluka kwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana. Imveliso yesilika yesaree ifuna ubuchwephesha bokulungisa umsonto, ukusebenza kwe-loom, ukwenziwa kwepateni, kunye nokugqiba ilaphu. Nangona unyaka ochanekileyo wemvelaphi ungasungulwa, i-Thirubuvanam ihlala iligama elibalulekileyo lengingqi kwilifa le-silk-weaving yaseTamil Nadu. Iisaree zayo zibonisa indlela amaziko okuluka ahlukeneyo aphuhlise ngayo izimbo kunye nodumo olwahlukileyo ngelixa enegalelo kwimbali ebanzi yelaphu laseMzantsi Indiya.
The Thirukkural by Thiruvalluvar: 1,330: I-Thirukkural nguThiruvalluvar: I-1,330 izibini ezinemigca emibini kwizahluko ze-133, zahlulahlulwe zaba ziincwadi ezintathu - iVirtue (Aram), Ubutyebi (iPorul), kunye noThando (Inbam). Iguqulelwe kwiilwimi ezininzi zehlabathi.
The Thirukkural could not be opened just: I-Thirukkural ayikwazanga ukuvulwa ngoku. Nceda uvale iskrola kwaye uzame kwakhona.
The three crowned kings of the Tamil lan: Ookumkani abathathu abathweswe izithsaba belizwe laseTamil ngamnye babenomfuziselo, yaye iingqekembe zabo zazithwele: ingwe yamaCholas, iintlanzi zasePandyas, nesaphetha samaChera. Funda kunye, ezi mpawu zixelela imbali yezopolitiko - xa ingqekembe yeChola ibonisa ingwe ejikelezwe yintlanzi yasePandya kunye nesaphetha seChera, ibhengeza ubukhosi bukaChola phezu kweembangi zakhe.
The Tirukkural contains 1,330 couplets a: I<em>Tirukkural iqulethe izibini ezitshatileyo ezili-1,330 ezilungelelaniswe zaba zizahluko ezili-133. Yahlulahlulwe yangamacandelo amathathu: Isidima, Ubutyebi nothando. Lo msebenzi uxoxa ngokuziphatha komntu, ubomi bosapho, ubuhlobo, imfundo, ulawulo, ubulungisa novelwano.
The Tirukkural has been translated into: I-Tirukkural iye yaguqulelwa kwiilwimi ezininzi, ivumela iingcamango zikaThiruvalluvar ukuba zifikelele kubafundi abangaphaya kwemida yoncwadi lwesiTamil.
The Tiruvalangadu plates of Rajendra I a: Amacwecwe eTiruvalangadu kaRajendra I kunye neeplate ze-Anbil ze-Sundara Chola ziyimithombo emikhulu yokuzalwa kunye nembali ye-Chola Dynasty.
The Tolkappiyam by Tolkappiyar is the ol: ITolkappiyam kaTolkappiyar yeyona grama indala yaphilayo yesiTamil. Iincwadi zayo ezintathu zigubungela oonobumba nezandi (Ezhuthu), amagama (Sol), kunye nombandela wobomi kunye nemibongo (Porul).
The udukkai is a small hourglass-shaped: I-udukkai ligubu elincinane elimile okwehourglass, iintloko zayo ezimbini ezidityaniswe ziintambo zoxinzelelo; ukukhama iintambo kunokutshintsha inowuthi. Ibanjwe ngesandla esinye kwaye ibethelwe kunye nesinye, ihamba kunye neengoma zokuzinikela, amabali abantu kunye nezenzo zesithethe - isikhumbuzo sendlela i-percussion esondeleyo, ukuzinikela kunye nokusebenza komlomo kuhlanganiswe kunye.
The ural and ulakkai were used to pound: I-ural kunye ne-ulakkai yayisetyenziselwa irayisi, i-millet, iinkozo kunye neziqholo. I<em>ural yayiyinqanawa eyomeleleyo, eyayidla ngokwenziwa ngomthi okanye ngelitye, ngoxa i<em>ulakkai yayisisixhobo eside sokungqisha. Bekunye, bancedisa ekususeni amakhoba, baqhekeze iinkozo kunye nokulungiselela izithako zokupheka. Izixhobo zikwabonisa umgudu womzimba kunye nomsebenzi okwabelwana ngawo kumalungiselelo okutya kwesintu.
The veenai (Saraswati veena) is one of t: I-veenai (i-Saraswati veena) sesinye sezixhobo zengcingo eziphambili zomculo weklasiki waseMzantsi Indian: i-resonator enkulu eyenziwe ngomthi, intamo ende ephithizelayo, iintambo kunye nezikhonkwane zokulungisa, zihlala zineresonator yesibini. Ukucofa kunye nokutyibiliza iintambo ngokuchasene ne-frets kunika umculo weCarnatic imihlobiso yawo emihle. Edibene noSaraswati, unkulunkulukazi wokufunda, kufuneka ahluke kwi-yazh yamandulo - efana nendima, kodwa kungekhona inzala yayo ngqo.
The walls of the Brihadeeswarar temple c: Iindonga zetempile yaseBrihadeeswarar ziphethe imibhalo emide yeRajaraja I edwelisa izibonelelo, abasebenzi betempile, amatye anqabileyo, kunye nezipho-irekhodi elimangalisayo letempile njengeziko.
The wooden plough, often drawn by cattle: Ikhuba leplanga, elalidla ngokutsalwa ziinkomo okanye ziinyathi, lalisetyenziselwa ukukhulula nokulungisa umhlaba wokulima ukuze kulinywe. Ngezixhobo zezandla zokutyala nokuhlakula, amarhengqa okuvuna, kunye nokubhula nokwela ukuze kucocwe iinkozo, yayiyeyeqela lezixhobo ezazisetyenziswa ngabahlali balimayo ukuba baqhelane nemihlaba yabo kunye nezityalo zabo baze bazidlulisele ukusuka kwesinye isizukulwana ukuya kwesinye.
The woodland and pastures, in the evenin: Ihlathi kunye namadlelo, ngorhatya lonyaka wemvula. Isithixo sayo nguMayon (Thirumal), kunye nentyatyambo yayo ijasmine (mullai). Umxholo wayo u-iruthal - ukulinda isigulane, njengoko iqhawekazi lilindele ukuba umyeni wakhe abuye ngaphambi kweemvula. Abantu bakhona ngabalusi abafuya iinkomo nabaxovula ibhotolo.
The works that arrange their verses land: Imisebenzi elungelelanisa iindinyana zabo ze-landscape nge-landscape - i-Ainkurunuru, i-Aintinai Aimpathu kunye ne-Ezhupathu, i-Tinaimozhi Aimpathu, i-Tinaimalai Nurraimpathu kunye ne-Kainnilai-kwii-palm-leaf bundles apho zikhutshelwe khona.
The world-famous Chola bronzes: how they: Iibronze zeChola ezidumileyo kwihlabathi: zenziwa njani yindlela elahlekileyo ye-wax, umfanekiso weNataraja, kunye ne-craft ephilayo ye-Swamimalai.
The yazh is one of the most distinctive: I-yazh sesinye sezona zixhobo zahlukileyo zoncwadi lwamandulo lwesiTamil: isixhobo somtya esixhwiliweyo, ngokubanzi njengohadi. I-Sangam isebenza njengePerumpanatrupadai, kunye neSilappatikaram, ichaza, kwaye yeye-panar, iibhadi ezijoyine imibongo kumculo. Abaphengululi babiza iifom ezininzi - i-periyazh, i-siriyazh, i-sakota yazh kunye ne-vil yazh - ukwakhiwa kwayo okuchanekileyo iitekisi azibonakalisi ngokupheleleyo, ngoko nayiphi na i-yazh ebonwayo namhlanje kukwakhiwa kwakhona. Sisixhobo ngokwaso, hayi nje i-veenai yokuqala.
These are food traditions associated wit: Ezi zizithethe zokutya ezinxulumene nembonakalo-mhlaba kunye noluntu loncwadi lweSangam, hayi iimenyu ezimiselweyo ezilandelwa ngumntu wonke. Izinto ezazityiwa ngabantu zahluka ngokwexesha, uluntu, ixesha lonyaka kunye norhwebo. Iifoto luyilo lwangoku olubonisa ukutya okuchazwa zizibhalo, hayi izitya zakudala.
Thirugnanasambandar, the 7th-century chi: I-Thirugnanasambandar, ingcwele yomntwana we-7th-century, enye ye-Shaiva Nayanmars enkulu eneengoma ezivula i-Tevaram. I-bronzes ye-Chola imbonisa njengenkwenkwana encinci idansa kwi-ecstasy, umnwe wakhe wesalathisi uphakamisele uShiva, owathi-ibali lihamba - wayemnike ubisi lobulumko obuvela kwibele likaParvati.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace represents the a: IThirumalai Nayak Palace imele ubukhazikhazi boyilo, inkcubeko yasebukhosini kunye nembali yezopolitiko yexesha leMadurai Nayak.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace was constructed: Ibhotwe leThirumalai Nayak lakhiwa ngenkulungwane yeshumi elinesixhenxe ngexesha lolawulo lukaKumkani uThirumalai Nayak wobukhosi baseMadurai Nayak. Eli bhotwe lalisebenza njengendawo yokuhlala yasebukhosini nesazulu sobomi basebhotwe. Uyilo lwayo ludityaniswe neentsika zokubeka, iiholo ezibanzi, iimpawu zokuhombisa kunye neempembelelo ezinxulumene nexesha leNayak. Iingxelo zembali zibonisa ukuba isakhiwo sebhotwe sangaphambili sasisikhulu kunenxalenye ekhoyo namhlanje.
Thirumurugatrupadai, Porunaratrupadai, S: Thirumurugatrupadai, Porunaratrupadai, Sirupanatrupadai, Perumpanatrupadai, Mullaippattu, Maduraikkanchi, Nedunalvadai, Kurinjippattu, Pattinappalai, kunye neMalaipadukadam. Le mibongo mide ibandakanya "imibongo yesikhokelo" (i-atrupadai), apho ibhadi iqondisa enye kumxhasi onesisa.
Thiruvalluvar is celebrated as one of th: I-Thiruvalluvar ibhiyozelwa njengenye yeembongi ezinkulu kwiincwadi zesiTamil. Ngokwesiko unikwe imbeko ngokuqamba iTirukkural, umsebenzi owaziwayo waseTamil ophonononga iinkalo ezintathu zobomi bomntu: isidima, ubutyebi nothando.
Thiruvalluvar occupies an important plac: I-Thiruvalluvar ithatha indawo ebalulekileyo kuncwadi lwesiTamil kunye nelifa lenkcubeko. Umfanekiso oqingqiweyo eKanyakumari naseValluvar Kottam eChennai zezinye zezikhumbuzo ezibalulekileyo ezinikezelwe kuye.
Thiruvalluvar’s 1330 couplets on virtue,: I-Thiruvalluvar's 1330 couplets ngobuhle, ubutyebi kunye nothando, ikopishwe nge-century yeshumi elinesithathu ye-Parimelazhagar, eyona nto ifundwe kwiinkcazo zakudala.
Thiruvalluvar’s teachings encourage peop: Iimfundiso zikaThiruvalluvar zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokunyanisekileyo, baphathe abanye ngobubele kwaye benze ngobulungisa. Today, Mamallapuram is a major heritage: Namhlanje, iMamallapuram yeyona ndawo yelifa lemveli eTamil Nadu eCoromandel Coast. Today, the principal surviving landmark: Namhlanje, indawo ephambili eseleyo yiTempile yaseGangaikondacholeeswaram. Traditional Tamil agriculture relied on: Ulimo lwesiTamil lwesiNtu lwaluxhomekeke kwizixhobo ezenzelwe ukulungisa umhlaba, ukuhlwayela imbewu, ukususa ukhula, ukuvuna izityalo kunye nokulungisa ukutya okuziinkozo. Ikhuba leplanga, elalidla ngokutsalwa ziinkomo okanye ziinyathi, lalisetyenziselwa ukukhulula nokulungisa umhlaba wokulima. Izixhobo zezandla zazinceda abalimi ukuba benze umsebenzi wokutyala nokulondoloza, ngoxa iirhengqa zazisetyenziselwa ukuvuna izityalo. Emva kokuvunwa, ukutya okuziinkozo kwakusahlulwa kwizikhondo ngokubhulwa kuze kucocwe ngokwelulwa. Izixhobo eziqhelekileyo zokuphakamisa amanzi zikwanceda amafama ukuba azise amanzi aphuma emaquleni, kumachibi nasematankini ukuya emasimini. Izixhobo ezichanekileyo kunye nobuchule bezohlukeneyo ngokwesityalo, ummandla kunye nexesha lembali. Ezi zixhobo zibonisa indlela abantu abalimayo abaphuhlise ngayo ubugcisa obusebenzayo obulungele iimeko zasekuhlaleni kwaye badlulisela ulwazi lwezolimo ukusuka kwesinye isizukulwana ukuya kwesinye.
Traditionally the author of the Tholkapp: Ngokuqhelekileyo umbhali weTholkappiyam, igrama yesiTamil endala esaphila, kwiindawo ezintathu - Ezhuthu (iileta), uSol (amagama) kunye nePorul (isihloko), apho i-kam kunye ne-puram izahlulo kunye nemihlaba ye-thidaii yemibongo yakudala ibekwe. Umhla nokubhalwa kwayo kusaxoxwa.
Iindidi ezimbini zobungqina zidibana kweli gumbi. KuVel Pari kunye noKarikala Cholan, kunye noKannagi, iqhawekazi laseSilappathikaram, sixhomekeke kwimibongo ye-Sangam kunye ne-epic, ecebileyo kwimemori kodwa kungekhona iirekhodi zangoku. Kwi-Medieval Cholas - uSembiyan Mahadevi, uRajaraja I kunye noRajendra I - imibhalo kwiindonga zetempile kunye namaphulo okurekhoda amacwecwe obhedu, izipho kunye nolawulo ngokubanzi.
Under the Nayaks of Thanjavur and Madura: Ngaphantsi kweNayaks yaseThanjavur kunye neMadurai (inkulungwane ye-16 ukuya kweye-18), iindonga zetempile kunye neesilingi zivutha ngotyheli, obomvu kunye noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka: izithixo ezenziwe ngamakhethini apeyintiweyo kunye neegarlands, ii-epics ezixelwe kwiibhendi ezide. Ukusuka kule nkcubeko yenkundla, eqhutywe ngabalawuli baseMaratha baseThanjavur, beza umzobo weTanjore - iphaneli yomthi kunye nelaphu, imifanekiso yayo ephakanyiswe kwisiqabu se-chaki kunye ne-gum, ehlanganiswe ngeqabunga legolide kwaye ibekwe ngeglasi okanye amatye anqabileyo. Uraiyur, in present-day Tiruchirappalli,: I-Uraiyur, kwi-Tiruchirappalli yanamhlanje, yayilikomkhulu elingaphakathi kwe-Cholas yokuqala - hayi izibuko. Iiakhawunti zeSangam-age ziyinxulumanisa namalaphu amahle; ilaphu alifane libekho emhlabeni, ngoko uncwadi nembali yommandla inamabali amaninzi. I-Uraiyur ibonisa indlela imveliso yangaphakathi kunye nolawulo lwasebukhosini ezondla ngayo iimarike zonxweme, nangona umthamo kunye neendawo zokurhweba zayo azikwazi ukulinganiswa ngokuchanekileyo.

Venkateswara, Vishnu as the lord of the: UVenkateswara, uVishnu njengenkosi yeenduli zeTirumala, eboniswe emi njengendawo yakhe edumileyo, egqunywe ngamatye anqabileyo kunye neentyatyambo. Vinayaka enthroned beneath a gilded arch: UVinayaka ubekwe etroneni ngaphantsi kwearch ehonjisiweyo, ihalo ebomvu emva kwakhe, impuku yakhe kunye nesitya seelekese ezinyaweni zakhe. Vinayaka seated at ease on a gilded thro: UVinayaka ehleli ngokukhululeka kwisihlalo sobukhosi esihonjisiweyo, umboko wakhe ujijekile ujonge kwiswiti, ephethe imviko kunye nentambo, ngempuku yakhe kunye nesitya semodakam kumgangatho obomvu. Ngokuchasene nomhlaba omnyama iarch ephakanyisiweyo, enamagqabi egolide, imihombiso neentyatyambo zigqama ngokungathi zikroliwe - umphumo wabapeyinti baseTanjore bafuna imifanekiso elungiselelwe ukunqulwa ekhaya.
Vinayaka, remover of obstacles, who is h: UVinayaka, umsusi wemiqobo, ohlonitshwa kuqala phambi kwaso nasiphi na isenzo. Abapeyinti beTanjore bammisa kwiziko phantsi kwe-arch, enobuso obujikelezileyo, obufana nomntwana, waza wakha isithsaba sakhe kunye namatye anqabileyo kwi-gesso ephakanyisiweyo egqunywe ngamagqabi egolide kunye namatye anemibala.
Vishnu standing, four-armed, holding his: UVishnu emi, exhobe ezine, ebambe idiscus yakhe neconchi ngezandla zakhe eziphezulu. Ookumkani basePallava babengabakhi abakhulu beShiva kunye noVishnu, kwaye lo mfanekiso uzolileyo, ongaphambili ubonisa indlela yokuqala, ephawulekayo eya kuthi kamva ilungiswe yiCholas.
Water management has played a major role: Ulawulo lwamanzi ludlale indima enkulu kwimbali yezolimo yaseTamil Nadu kuba imvula iyahluka ngamaxesha onyaka kunye nemimandla. Amafama emveli ayesebenzisa imilambo, amaqula, amachibi, imisele namatanki okunkcenkceshela ukuxhasa ukulima. Esinye sezona zakhiwo zibalulekileyo zembali zokunkcenkceshela yiKallanai, okanye iGrand Anicut, ngaphesheya koMlambo iKaveri. Ngokuqhelekileyo kuthiwa yinkosi yeChola uKarikala, yakhiwe ukulawula kunye nokuguqula amanzi omlambo ukunkcenkceshela. Imimandla yezolimo yaseTamil nayo yaphuhlisa uthungelwano lwamatanki kunye nemijelo eqokelele kwaye isasaze amanzi emvula ngamaxesha athile onyaka. Ezi nkqubo zixhasa ukulima kwiindawo apho imvula iyodwa yayinganelanga. Ukugcinwa kwazo kufuna intsebenziswano phakathi koluntu nolawulo olunenkathalo lobutyebi bamanzi. Ukunkcenkceshela kwendabuko kuhlala kungumxholo obalulekileyo wokuqonda ubudlelwane phakathi kwezolimo, ubunjineli, ukuhlaliswa, kunye nokulungiswa kokusingqongileyo eTamil Nadu.
Water pots made from clay or metal were: Iimbiza zamanzi ezenziwe ngodongwe okanye isinyithi zazisetyenziselwa ukuqokelela, ukuthwala nokugcina amanzi okusela. Iingqayi zodongwe zazixatyiswa kumakhaya amaninzi kuba amanzi agcinwe kudongwe olunemingxuma anokuphola xa ephuma emoyeni. Ukusetyenziswa kwazo kwakuxhomekeke kwizinto zasekuhlaleni, amasiko kunye nokufikelela emanzini.
Water spills over the anicut when the Ka: Amanzi achitha phezu kwe-anicut xa i-Kaveri ibaleka phezulu. Ifilimu ikhumbula ukuba kutheni idama lalifuneka: kwisikhukula umlambo waqhekeza iindonga zawo waza watshayela amasimi kunye needolophana, njengoko kamva irekhodi yeChola. Weaving in Tamil Nadu from ancient times: Ukwaluka kwiTamil Nadu ukusuka kumaxesha amandulo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku - umqhaphu, isilika, idayi kunye nomsonto welaphu lakudala laseTamil, amanyathelo amahlanu ukusuka kwifayibha ukuya kwilaphu, kunye nebali labaluki bexesha leSangam, izikumkani zamaxesha aphakathi, ulawulo lobukoloniyali nanamhlanje.
Weaving is more than a craft: it connect: Ukwaluka kungaphezulu kobugcisa: idibanisa iimpahla zemihla ngemihla, ezolimo, itekhnoloji, urhwebo, abasebenzi abanezakhono, inkcubeko yenkcubeko kunye nokuphila koluntu lwaseTamil ukutyhubela iinkulungwane. Izixhobo zayo ekrwada yayiyiparuthi (umqhaphu), umsonto omkhulu ophothiweyo ube ngumsonto kwaye ulukwe ube lilaphu; i-pattu (isilika), eyaziwa kwizithethe zamalaphu zaseMzantsi Asia, nangona imicu eyayisetyenziswa yayahluka ngokwamaxesha kunye nendawo; iidayi zezityalo ezifana ne-indigo, ezixoxwe kwiimbekiselo zokuqala ze-Tamil textile; kunye ne-nool (umsonto), i-fiber ephothiweyo okanye ephothiweyo ibe ngumsonto oqhubekayo olungele ukuluka.
What each landscape gave its people to e: Yintoni i-landscape nganye yanika abantu bayo ukuba badle: i-millet, ubusi kunye neziqhamo zasendle kwiinduli zaseKurinji, ubisi, i-curd kunye ne-buttermilk kumadlelo e-Mullai, irayisi kunye ne-pulses emasimini ase-Marutham, intlanzi, intlanzi eyomileyo kunye netyuwa kunxweme lwe-Neithal, kunye nezibonelelo eziqhutywe kwiindlela ezomileyo zasePalai.
When water could not flow naturally from: Xa amanzi engakwazi ukuhamba ngokwemvelo esuka emlanjeni, etankini okanye equleni ukuya entsimini, amafama ayefuna iindlela zokuwanyusa. Imisebenzi yezolimo yaseTamil yesiNtu ibandakanya izixhobo zokuphakamisa amanzi ngesandla ezifana neebhakethi, iibhaskithi kunye neendlela ezisebenza nge-lever. I<em>picottah, edla ngokuchazwa njengesixhobo sokusebenza esinentambo elinganayo, yayinceda umntu akwazi ukuphakamisa amanzi ngomzamo omncinane kunokuwaphatha ngesandla. Isixhobo esiqhelekileyo se-lever sisebenzisa ipali ende exhaswa kwi-pivot, enesitya esincanyathiselwe kwelinye icala kunye ne-counterweight kwelinye. Ezi zixhobo beziluncedo kakhulu kwiziza ezincinci, ukulima igadi kunye namasimi aphezu komphakamo wamanzi.
Where rain was scarce and the land drier: Apho imvula yayinqongophele kwaye umhlaba womile, amafama aseTamil akhulisa iimilithi ezinje ngekambu kunye ne varagu, ecaleni kwepulses, sesame kunye nomqhaphu. Ukukhetha izivuno ezihambelana nomhlaba ngamnye, imvula kunye nonikezelo lwamanzi yayilulwazi lwemibongo yeSangam esele ibonisiwe - kwaye iimillet zihlala phakathi kwezityalo ezinkulu zaseTamil Nadu namhlanje.

With the imperial Cholas came a confiden: Kunye neCholas yasebukhosini yeza ingqekembe yegolide, isilivere kunye nobhedu. Iingqekembe ze-Uttama Chola ngasekupheleni kwenkulungwane ye-10 ziphethe igama lakhe, kwaye ukusuka eRajaraja I ukuya phambili umfuziselo wasebukhosini ubonisa ihlosi leChola elihleli ecaleni kweentlanzi ezimbini zePandya phantsi kweparasol, enegama lokumkani kwiscript sesiNagari. Emva kokunqoba kweChola eSri Lanka, uhlobo lobhedu olubonisa ukumkani omileyo kwelinye icala kunye nomfanekiso ohleli kwelinye usasazeka kulo lonke elaseMzantsi Indiya kunye nesiqithi.
